key_insight: Neuron-OPSD uses internal neuron activations to choose better training data and build teacher context, enabling annotation-free self-distillation that improves specialized-domain performance without sacrificing generalization.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical post-training strategy for domain-specific LLMs when human labels, online feedback, or reward annotation are too expensive or unavailable.
method: Select training examples using neuron-activation signals rather than labels.
Construct a stronger teacher by adding context and aggregating on-policy rollouts.
Train the student by distilling from the teacher distribution with no ground-truth supervision.
evidence_signal: The method is evaluated on specialized-domain benchmarks and is reported to improve in-domain accuracy while preserving cross-domain performance and reducing calibration collapse versus prior annotation-free baselines.
watch_item: Because the approach depends on activation-based selection and on-policy rollouts, performance may be sensitive to model architecture, context design, and rollout stability.
paper_title: Neuron-Aware Data Selection for Annotation-Free LLM Self-Distillation
